_note: The fee for entering a vehicle in the Slovak register, položka 65 of the administrative fees act. Since 1 July 2023 it is the rate for the engine power multiplied by an ecological coefficient tied to the emission standard — the age of the car no longer enters it. The standard is read off the technical certificate; we derive it from the year of first registration, taking the later side of each boundary year so the fee is never understated.

source.title: Zákon 145/1995 Z. z. o správnych poplatkoch, položka 65 (slov-lex.sk)
